shows.title: Kent Monkman: Officer and Laughing Girl
shows.summary: The Frick Collection presents an installation of new paintings by Kent Monkman, exploring themes of colonization and representation inspired by Johannes Vermeer's 'Officer and Laughing Girl'.

shows.title: Siena: The Art of Bronze, 1450–1500
shows.summary: An exhibition focusing on Sienese bronze sculpture during the Italian Renaissance, featuring works from Tuscany.
